# Heli Naik

> > Heli Naik offers online watercolor and ink painting classes taught by a professional watercolor artist, with flexible membership plans for creative learners of all levels.

Heli Naik is an online art education platform specializing in watercolor and ink painting instruction. The site features structured courses, membership options, and booking for both art classes and complementary yoga offerings.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Online art instruction
- Watercolor & Ink
- Membership plans
- Painting tutorials
- Creative courses
- Beginner-friendly
- Mixed-media
- Monthly subscription
- Art education
- Anusara Yoga
- Yin Yoga
- Hatha Yoga
- Restorative Yoga

- [Online Watercolor Classes | Heli Naik](https://www.helinaik.com): Homepage showcasing Heli Naik's online watercolor classes and tutorials
- [Classes | Heli Naik](https://www.helinaik.com/programs): Main classes page featuring watercolor and ink painting instruction programs
- [Book Online | Heli Naik](https://www.helinaik.com/book-online): Online booking for yoga classes including Anusara, Yin, Hatha, Restorative
